description: Sri Lanka Institute of Architects - List of "Chartered Architects" "Architects" and   "Architectural Licentiaties"  Registered in the ARB for the year 2020
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the registration and renewal of professional architects (Chartered Architects, Architects, and Architectural Licentiates) by the Architects Registration Board. This falls under public sector professional registration and certification, which is a function of public service administration. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3), nor does it fit the specialized categories of land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters.
